meta.title: Reference values: incomes, household wealth, budgets
meta.description: Benchmarks the visualisations compare extreme wealth against. Values marked auto:false are maintained semi-automatically: the pipeline flags them when they exceed max_age_months and opens an issue with the refresh hint.

de_median_gross_annual_fulltime.source: Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), Pressemitteilung Nr. 113 vom April 2026: Mittlerer Bruttojahresverdienst lag 2025 bei 54 066 Euro
de_median_gross_annual_fulltime.definition: Median gross annual earnings of full-time employees in Germany including special payments (Verdiensterhebung 2025). Median: half of all full-time employees earn less, half earn more.
de_median_gross_annual_fulltime.refresh_hint: Destatis publishes the annual Verdiensterhebung results each April: https://www.destatis.de/DE/Themen/Arbeit/Verdienste/Verdienste-Branche-Berufe/Tabellen/bruttojahresverdienst.html

de_mean_gross_annual_fulltime.source: Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), Pressemitteilung Nr. 113 vom April 2026
de_mean_gross_annual_fulltime.definition: Arithmetic mean of gross annual earnings of full-time employees in Germany including special payments, 2025.

de_median_gross_monthly_fulltime.source: Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), Durchschnittliche Bruttoverdienste und Arbeitszeiten April 2025
de_median_gross_monthly_fulltime.definition: Median gross monthly earnings of full-time employees in Germany, survey month April 2025, without special payments.
de_median_gross_monthly_fulltime.refresh_hint: Destatis table 'Bruttomonatsverdienste im Stichmonat April', updated each spring.

us_median_household_income.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Income in the United States: 2025 (P60-289), released 15 September 2026
us_median_household_income.definition: Real median household income in the United States in 2025 (Current Population Survey ASEC). Household income, not individual earnings, so it is not directly comparable with the German full-time median earnings figure.
us_median_household_income.refresh_hint: Census P60 income report, published every September: https://www.census.gov/topics/income-poverty/income.html

de_median_net_wealth_household.source: Deutsche Bundesbank, Monatsbericht April 2025: Vermögen und Finanzen privater Haushalte in Deutschland – Ergebnisse der Vermögensbefragung 2023 (PHF)
de_median_net_wealth_household.definition: Median net wealth per household in Germany (nominal, 2023 survey wave of the Panel on Household Finances). Net wealth = real assets + financial assets − debts; pension entitlements excluded.
de_median_net_wealth_household.refresh_hint: The PHF is surveyed every 2–3 years; results appear in the Bundesbank Monatsbericht: https://www.bundesbank.de/de/bundesbank/forschung/studie-zur-wirtschaftlichen-lage-privater-haushalte-phf/ergebnisse-604886

de_mean_net_wealth_household.source: Deutsche Bundesbank, Monatsbericht April 2025: Ergebnisse der Vermögensbefragung 2023 (PHF)
de_mean_net_wealth_household.definition: Arithmetic mean net wealth per household in Germany (nominal, PHF 2023).
de_mean_net_wealth_household.refresh_hint: Same Bundesbank PHF release as de_median_net_wealth_household.

de_households_count.source: Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), Haushalte und Familien – Mikrozensus 2024
de_households_count.definition: Number of private main-residence households in Germany (Mikrozensus 2024, rounded to 0.1 million).
de_households_count.refresh_hint: Destatis Mikrozensus household tables, updated yearly.

de_total_household_net_wealth.source: Derived: Bundesbank PHF 2023 mean net wealth × Destatis household count (see derived.formula)
de_total_household_net_wealth.definition: Approximate total net wealth of all private households in Germany, calculated as PHF mean net wealth (2023) multiplied by the number of households (2024). A rough order of magnitude; the PHF itself under-covers the very top of the distribution.
de_total_household_net_wealth.estimate_by: Calculation from two official inputs (formula shown); the underlying inputs are official statistics.

us_median_net_worth_family.source: Federal Reserve Board, Changes in U.S. Family Finances from 2019 to 2022 (Survey of Consumer Finances), October 2023
us_median_net_worth_family.definition: Median net worth of U.S. families in 2022 (SCF; net worth = assets − liabilities). The SCF is conducted every three years; the 2025 wave had not been published when this value was retrieved.
us_median_net_worth_family.refresh_hint: Federal Reserve SCF page: https://www.federalreserve.gov/econres/scfindex.htm (next wave: 2025 data, expected late 2026).

de_lifetime_earnings_median_derived.source: Derived: Destatis median gross annual full-time earnings 2025 × 45 working years (see derived.formula)
de_lifetime_earnings_median_derived.definition: Illustrative gross lifetime earnings of a median full-time earner in Germany: the 2025 median gross annual earnings (54 066 €) multiplied by 45 working years, in today's euros, with no wage growth and no unemployment. It is an upper-bound simplification; the IAB-Kurzbericht 18/2022 reports modelled gross lifetime earnings of 1.10–2.49 million € for full-time employees with vocational training (age 18–66), depending on occupation.
de_lifetime_earnings_median_derived.estimate_by: Calculation from an official input (formula shown); cross-checked against IAB-Kurzbericht 18/2022: https://doku.iab.de/kurzber/2022/kb2022-18.pdf

us_lifetime_earnings_high_school.source: Georgetown University Center on Education and the Workforce, The College Payoff: More Education Doesn't Always Mean More Earnings (2021)
us_lifetime_earnings_high_school.definition: Median lifetime earnings (ages 25–64, in 2020 dollars) of U.S. workers whose highest qualification is a high-school diploma. Bachelor's degree holders: 2.8 million USD in the same report.
us_lifetime_earnings_high_school.estimate_by: Georgetown CEW (model based on American Community Survey data)
us_lifetime_earnings_high_school.refresh_hint: Check cew.georgetown.edu for a newer College Payoff edition.

de_federal_budget_2026.source: Deutscher Bundestag, Haushaltsgesetz 2026 (3. Lesung, 28. November 2025): Ausgaben von 524,54 Milliarden Euro
de_federal_budget_2026.definition: Total expenditure of the German federal budget for 2026 as passed by the Bundestag (excluding Länder and municipalities, and excluding the special funds outside the core budget).
de_federal_budget_2026.refresh_hint: Bundestag text archive on the next Haushaltsgesetz (usually passed in November/December).

de_billionaires_count.source: Oxfam Deutschland, Pressemitteilung 19. Januar 2026 (Bericht zur sozialen Ungleichheit 2026), based on the Forbes billionaires list as of 30 November 2025
de_billionaires_count.definition: Number of German billionaires (net worth ≥ 1 billion USD) according to Forbes data as compiled by Oxfam.
de_billionaires_count.refresh_hint: Oxfam publishes its inequality report every January before Davos.

de_billionaires_total_wealth.source: Oxfam Deutschland, Pressemitteilung 19. Januar 2026, based on Forbes data as of 30 November 2025
de_billionaires_total_wealth.definition: Combined net worth of all German billionaires (Forbes estimates compiled by Oxfam), in USD.

world_billionaires_count.source: Forbes, The World's Billionaires 2026 (annual list API, retrieved by the pipeline)
world_billionaires_count.definition: Number of people on the Forbes World's Billionaires list 2026.
world_billionaires_count.refresh_hint: Forbes publishes the annual list each spring; the pipeline reads https://www.forbes.com/forbesapi/person/billionaires/<year>/position/true.json

eurojackpot_max.source: LOTTO.de, Eurojackpot-Höchstgewinne: in Gewinnklasse 1 sind seit dem 25. März 2022 maximal 120 Millionen Euro möglich
eurojackpot_max.definition: Maximum prize in Eurojackpot prize category 1 (jackpot cap) under the rules valid since 25 March 2022; reached several times, e.g. 23 September 2025 (Germany) and 26 May 2026 (Czechia).

powerball_record_jackpot.source: Powerball (Multi-State Lottery Association): Ticket in California wins world record $2.04 billion Powerball jackpot, 8 November 2022
powerball_record_jackpot.definition: Largest lottery jackpot ever, as an annuity value (30 payments); the winner took the lump sum of 997.6 million USD before taxes.
